title: linhanwang/GlanceWAM
abstract:
Repo of "GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models"

# GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models [ ](https://linhanwang.github.io/glancewam/) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23927) [ ](https://huggingface.co/datasets/LinhanWang/GlanceWAM) [ ](LICENSE) GlanceWAM decouples visual imagination from control inside one video DiT: it glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single latent lookahead frame ≈3 s into the future, while the action head decodes action chunks against it at control rate (48 ms per chunk), never blocking on generation. Trained on demonstrations only, it reaches 72.2% on RoboCasa kitchen and 99.0% on LIBERO. Real-robot videos are on the [project page](https://linhanwang.github.io/glancewam/). Backbone: [SkyReels-V2 DF 1.3B](https://huggingface.co/Skywork/SkyReels-V2-DF-1.3B-540P-Diffusers). Framework: [`glancewam/model/framework/wam/GlanceWAM.py`](glancewam/model/framework/wam/GlanceWAM.py). ## Installation Evaluation also needs a simulator, installed as a sibling directory (it talks to the policy server over a websocket): - **LIBERO** — `bash examples/LIBERO/eval_files/install_libero.sh` (creates `../LIBERO`) - **RoboCasa kitchen** — see [its eval README](examples/Robocasa_kitchen/eval_files/README.md) §0 ## Data and checkpoints Datasets (LeRobot v3, UMT5 text cache included) and released checkpoints are one bundle on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/LinhanWang/GlanceWAM): | Checkpoint | Benchmark | Success rate | |---|---|---| | `glancewam_robocasa_kitchen` | RoboCasa kitchen, 24 tasks × 50 episodes | 0.721 | | `glancewam_libero` | LIBERO, 4 suites × 500 episodes | 0.989 | Bringing your own data: build the UMT5 text cache first with `examples/ /train_files/run_precompute_umt5_skyreels.sh`. ## Training Reference setup is 4×H200 with global batch 128 (4 GPUs × 16 per device × grad-accum 2); keep that product fixed if you change the GPU count. Common overrides (env vars): `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, `DATA_ROOT`, `DATA_MIX`, `RUN_ID`, `MAX_TRAIN_STEPS`, `PRETRAINED_CHECKP

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：在单个视频 DiT（SkyReels-V2 DF 1.3B）中把视觉想象与控制解耦：以慢时钟稀疏地"瞥一眼"未来，想象一个约 3 秒后的单帧 latent lookahead，动作头则在此条件下以控制频率（每 chunk 48 ms）解码动作块，整个过程不阻塞于帧生成。


# 一、动机

> 世界-动作模型（World-Action Model）通常把视觉想象与动作生成耦合在同一条推理路径上，视频生成的高延迟会拖慢甚至阻塞控制回路，难以满足真实机器人所需的高频闭环控制。


# 二、方法

> 在单个视频 DiT（SkyReels-V2 DF 1.3B）中把视觉想象与控制解耦：以慢时钟稀疏地"瞥一眼"未来，想象一个约 3 秒后的单帧 latent lookahead，动作头则在此条件下以控制频率（每 chunk 48 ms）解码动作块，整个过程不阻塞于帧生成。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 仅用演示数据训练（无 RL / 无额外奖励），在 RoboCasa kitchen 上 24 个任务 × 50 episodes 达到 72.2%（checkpoint 报 0.721），在 LIBERO 上 4 个 suite × 500 episodes 达到 99.0%（checkpoint 报 0.989）；动作块解码延迟为 48 ms/chunk，视觉想象以慢时钟异步进行，参考训练配置为 4×H200、global batch 128。


# 四、对我的启发

> 核心启发是"想象不必与控制在时间轴上同步"——用慢时钟的稀疏 lookahead 换取控制回路的高频实时性，这一解耦思路可迁移到其他延迟敏感的具身策略；局限在于仍依赖视频 DiT 骨干与仿真/数据混合，单帧 latent lookahead 的表达能力及长时程误差累积有待验证，真实机器人结果目前只在项目页以视频形式展示。
